name: Lacrimosa

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the fifth round, then the final count

categories.label: VP on score track before final count
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi kết toán
categories.hint: VP gained during the game (track plus any +50 marker).

categories.label: Royal Court tiles fulfilled
categories.labelVi: Thẻ Hoàng cung đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: VP of each fulfilled Royal Court tile; each Opus / Requiem marker can satisfy only one tile. Enter the VP of each tile.

categories.label: Requiem markers scored
categories.hint: Per movement: your markers matching the majority composer score the higher value, the other composer the lower; both score lower on a tie; neutral markers score nothing. Enter the VP of each of your markers.

categories.label: Story Points left
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 Story Points left (tracks on personal board plus counters).

categories.label: Requiem markers contributed (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số marker Requiem đã đóng góp (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Total of your markers on the Requiem.

categories.label: Opus cards in front of you (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Opus cards still in front of you.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Final count order: Royal Court tiles, Requiem, Story Points, money. Solo (Soloist automa) rules exist and are not modelled; solo also scores the Requiem normally.

sources.title: Lacrimosa Rulebook
sources.section: p.11-12 Royal Court tiles obtained, Score the Requiem, Conclusion of the story, Money, winner and tiebreakers
